ኀበ: ኀበ — to, toward, at; where (preposition / conjunction) · 'with, in the possession of' (ኢተርፈት ኀበ ኢዮርብዓም 'it did not remain with Jeroboam')
ለጽዮን: ጽዮን — of/for Zion · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (አንሥእዋ ለጽዮን 'they raised Zion') · naming the owner after a suffix (ምንባሪሃ ለጽዮን 'the seat of Zion'; እምላዕሌሃ ለጽዮን 'from upon Zion', ch. 56)
ወቦአ: ቦአ — and he entered (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, b-w-ʾ)
ውስተ: ውስተ — in, within, into · to, among (ወለአከ ውስተ ኵሉ ነጋድያን 'and he sent to all the merchants') · at (ውስተ መድረከ ኆኃቲሃ 'at the threshold of her doors')
ወበከየ: በከየ — and he wept (ወ- 'and' + 3ms perfect, G, b-k-y)
ይብል: ብህለ — he says (3ms imperfect, G stem, defective verb b-h-l)
ለታቦተ: ታቦት — to/of the ark (ለ- + noun, construct 'ark of') · marking the object, doubled by the suffix on the verb (ወንሥኣ ለታቦተ ሕጉ 'and take the Ark of his law')
ባሕቱ: ባሕቱ — but, however, nevertheless (conjunction; አላ ባሕቱ 'but nevertheless')
አንተሰ: አንተ — you indeed (2ms pronoun + contrastive enclitic -ሰ)
አበዊነ: አብ — our fathers (noun, plural አበው, stem አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ለጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — justice, righteousness (ለ- + noun; naming what suffix -ā pointed to)
እስራኤል: እስራኤል — Israel (proper name; vocative) · dependent on a construct (ኀያላነ እስራኤል 'the mighty ones of Israel'; ch. 53) · also plain 'Israel', as subject or in ደቂቀ እስራኤል 'children of Israel' (ተሀየይዎ እስራኤል 'Israel ...', ch. 55–56)
አሠረ: አሠር — track, footprint; አሠረ እሙ 'behind his mother' (noun, construct, used as preposition 'after')
በአርአያ: አርአያ — after the pattern of, in the likeness of (በ- + noun, construct)
ለማኅደረ: ማኅደር — for the dwelling of (ለ- 'for' + noun, construct)
ከመ: ከመ — that, so that; as · 'like' before a noun (ከመ ምድረ በረድ 'like a land of hail') · ከመ ኢ- 'that not, lest' (ከመ ኢትንገሥ ብእሲት 'that a woman not reign'; ከመ ኢታቅሞ 'that you not make him stay') · 'as when' before ዘ- or አመ (ከመ ዘ ዐገትዋ 'as when they besieged her')
እምነ: እም — from, out of (preposition, እምነ before a noun) · 'our mother' (እም 'mother' + -ነ 'our'): ይብልዋ ለጽዮን እምነ 'they will call Zion "our mother"' · 'than' in a comparison (ተፈሥሑ ፈድፋደ እምነ እስራኤል 'rejoiced more than Israel')
ሀለወት: ሀለወ — she was, she was present (3fs perfect, h-l-w)
ወበእንተዝ: በእንተዝ — and on this account (ወ- + preposition + demonstrative)
ገጸከ: ገጽ — your face (noun + -ከ '2ms your', stem ገጸ- before the suffix)
ለአበዊነ: አብ — to our fathers (ለ- + plural አበው, አበዊ- + -ነ '1cp our')
ዳዊት: ዳዊት — David (proper name) · 'ዳዊት' also in ማኅፈደ ዳዊት 'tower (?) of David' (genitive after a construct) · also the young prince Menelik, styled David (እግዚእክሙ ዳዊት 'your lord David')
ፈቀደ: ፈቀደ — he wished, wanted, desired (3ms perfect, G)
ይሕንጽ: ሐነጸ — that he build (3ms subjunctive, G, after ከመ)
ቃለ: ቃል — word (construct 'word of') · accusative 'a word' (ዘንተ ቃለ 'this word') · 'voice of' in the title ቃለ ታዕካ (?)
ዘይቤ: ብህለ — who said, which he said (ዘ- + 3m sg perfect, defective verb b-h-l)
አኮኑ: አኮ — is it not so? are we not? (negative አኮ + interrogative -ኑ)
ዘኵሎ: ኵሉ — who (over) all (ዘ- + ኵሉ accusative; ዘኵሎ ይመልክ 'who rules all')
ይመልክ: መልከ — he rules, reigns over (3ms imperfect, G, m-l-k)
ወዘንተ: ዝንቱ — and this (ወ- + accusative ዘንተ, demonstrative)
ኀለየ: ኀለየ — he thought, reflected (3ms perfect, ḫ-l-y)
ዘወፅአ: ወፅአ — that which went out (ዘ- 'which' + 3ms perfect, G, w-ṣ-ʾ)
ሊተ: ሊተ — to me, me (1s pronoun, dative/oblique)
መሥዋዕተ: መሥዋዕት — offering, sacrifice (construct 'offering of') · also accusative 'a sacrifice' (ያዐርጉ መሥዋዕተ 'they offer a sacrifice')
ወመልአ: መልአ — and he filled (ወ- + 3ms perfect, G, m-l-ʾ)
ኵሉ: ኵሉ — all, every, the whole of · 'everyone', used alone (ያፈቅር ኵሉ 'everyone loves') · ወበዝ ኵሉ 'and in all this'
በነጽሮ: ነጸረ — by seeing (በ- + verbal noun ነጽሮ of ነጸረ 'look')
ለእለ: እለ — those who, who (plural relative pronoun; ለ- 'to, for')
አ: አ — [ʾa], question particle (?) (written detached from the verb)
ለዘ: ዘ — he who, that which (relative pronoun; ለ- 'to')
ኢኮነ: ኮነ — he did not become (ኢ- 'not' + 3ms perfect, G, k-w-n) · 'is not' with a predicate (ዝሰ ኢኮነ አምላክ 'this is not a god'; ch. 13)
ርሕቀ: ርሕቅ — distance, remoteness (noun, construct 'distance of'; the lemma is inferred from the form: ርሕቀት would give construct ርሕቀተ, and Dillmann is unavailable, so unconfirmed)
እምኔከ: እም — from you (preposition እም with suffix -ኔከ '2ms')
በእንተ: በእንተ — concerning, about (+ construct) · for the sake of, on account of (በእንተ ፍሥሓ አዳም 'for the joy of Adam')
ተንሥእ: ተንሥአ — arise! (2ms imperative, Gt, root n-s-ʾ)
ምስሌየ: ምስለ — with me (preposition, stem ምስሌ- + -የ '1cs me')
ወነሥኣ: ነሥአ — and he took her (ወ- + 3ms perfect, n-ś-ʾ + -ኣ 'her')
ለእግዝእትነ: እግዝእት — our lady, for/of our lady (ለ- + noun, fem. + -ነ '1cp our'; marks the object, doubled by the suffix of ነሢኦታ)
ጽድቅ: ጽድቅ — righteousness, justice (noun; ፀሐየ ጽድቅ 'sun of righteousness')
ኮነ: ኮነ — he became, was (3m sg perfect, k-w-n) · 3ms form used here where 'we became' is meant (እንዘ ጠቢባን ኮነ አብዳነ; 1cp would be ኮንነ; sic) · 'if it is' after ለእመ (ወለእመ ኮነ ተባዕተ 'and if it is male'); impersonal 'when it was to him' of years (ሶበ ኮነ ሎቱ ፳ወ፪ ዓመተ 'when he was twenty-two')
ኅሱራነ: ኅሱር — lacking, deficient (adjective, accusative plural ኅሱራነ)
ለእጓለ: እጓል — to the child of (ለ- + noun, construct 'child of'; እጓለ ማውታ 'orphan')
ማውታ: ሙት — the dead; carrion (plural ማውታ, cf. ዕጓለ ማውታ 'orphan', lit. 'child of the dead'; sense here uncertain)
አሌለነ: አሌ — woe to us (interjection አሌ + ለ- + -ነ '1cp us')
ኀለፈት: ኀለፈ — it passed away (3fs perfect, ḫ-l-f)
ኮኑ: ኮነ — they became (3mp perfect, k-w-n) · 'so they were' in a simile (ከማሁ ኮኑ 'thus they were')
አውየዉ: አውየወ — they cried out, wailed (3mp perfect; related to the noun አውያት 'wailing') (?)
ወከልሑ: ከልሐ — and they shouted (ወ- + 3mp perfect, k-l-ḥ)
ለነ: ለ — to us, for us (ለ- + 1cp suffix -ነ) · 'over us' (ንገሢ ለነ 'reign over us')
ክብራ: ክብር — her glory (noun + -ሃ 'her', anticipating ለጽዮን 'of Zion'; not a construct)
መከረ: መከረ — he took counsel, advised (3ms perf., G, m-k-r)
ወኵሉ: ኵሉ — and all, every (ወ- + noun, before a noun with suffix) · and everyone (ወኵሉ ያነክር 'and everyone marvels')
ወአልቦ: አልቦ — and there is not (ወ- 'and' + negative existential)
ነሥአ: ነሥአ — he took (3ms perfect, G, n-ś-ʾ)
ሰብአ: ሰብእ — man (accusative) · construct 'men of' (ሰብአ ቤቱ 'men of his house')
ያፈቅር: አፍቀረ — he loves (3ms imperfect, causative; ፍቅር 'love')
